name: dieHalle Aachen
notes:
Just over the German border from Limburg, 1500 m² of boulder walls from
slab to steep overhang, plus a roped section. Worth the drive from
Maastricht.

name: Klimhal Centraal
notes:
15m roped wall right by Amsterdam Centraal, roof opens in summer. Great for
lead practice, terrace by the water is a nice bonus after a session.

name: Monk Bouldergym Amsterdam
notes:
Boulder-only gym on the IJ river in Amsterdam-Noord. Good variety of overhangs
and slabs, brushes everywhere so the holds stay clean. Circuits refresh
roughly every month.

name: Monk Bouldergym Hasselt
notes:
Monk's Belgian outpost right in the Hasselt city centre. ~200 boulders,
café and shop on site, good for a road-trip stop.

name: Klimcentrum Neoliet Eindhoven-Zuid
notes:
On the list — lead wall + rock wall + klettersteig at the Fontys Sport
Hogeschool site. Haven't been yet.

name: Boulderzaal The Island
notes:
One of Belgium's newest, largest bouldering gyms. Relaxed vibe, slackline
and table tennis in the workout area. Still need to visit.
